notes:
GalleryKnife is now signed with its own permanent release key.

IMPORTANT if you already have an older version (1.0 to 1.1.1): Android will not update it in place because the signing key changed. Uninstall the old version first, then install this one. Anything hidden in the Private album and named faces in the old version are erased on uninstall, so restore your hidden photos to the gallery first (open a photo in Private and tap Restore). From this version on, updates install normally inside the app.

New installs are not affected.
